info.title: MAFW Gateway API — SDK-facing contract
info.description: P4 生成的契约：paths 由 gateway routes/route-catalog.ts 经 emit-openapi 脚本产出（gateway-paths.json），本文件 = gateway-paths.json + overrides.json（手写 summary/description/responseSchema 元数据）合并产物，勿手改。变更链路：route-catalog.ts → (gateway) npm run emit:openapi → (sdk) npm run gen:api → api-schema.gen.ts。tags 含 internal 的 operation 不被 @mafw/sdk 调用（服务端内部/dashboard/mobile 用）。

Dismiss = reject alias (state REJECTED), ledger reason triage_dismissed. Route added 2026-09-17 fixing SDK drift bug.
Raw octet-stream, ?type=. Must go through Node network stack (Chromium fetch hangs behind system proxies). SDK helper media.upload().
